info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Facility By Param1-spec
info.description: The Facility Management API enables users to modify specific details of facilities within the equipment administration system. Through the PATCH method, consumers can update attributes based on the provided identifier (param1). This API is particularly useful for administrators and operations teams needing to refine facility configurations, ensuring optimal performance and compliance. Typical use cases include adjusting specifications, managing resource allocations, and tracking changes to facility setups.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific equipment administration resource associated with a facility. You can change various attributes related to the equipment's administration, ensuring that all relevant information is current and accurate.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the equipment administration details for the specified resource. Ensure that all required fields are populated correctly to achieve the desired modification.
